1981-2415-7918-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
1981-2415-7918-8227.description:
Activate Loot by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Sifa Grent and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

4311-4478-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2034-4289-6970-7297-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

475-3197-6824-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
475-3197-6824-7810.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

1987-2510-4863.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that taps to produce at least {U}
1987-2510-4863.notablePrerequisites: There is an instant card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
1987-2510-4863.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Revolutionist.
When Revolutionist enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2510-4863.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

1987-5913-6573.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-5913-6573.notablePrerequisites: You've cast a commander from the command zone two or more times this game.
1987-5913-6573.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Pinnacle Monk
When Pinnacle Monk enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-5913-6573.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

539-2438-7031.description:
Cast Badgermole by paying its mana cost
When Badgermole enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Badgermole
When Badgermole dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Badgermole enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1395-1987-4045-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Ur-Golem's Eye by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}.
Elsha's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve Ghostly Flicker, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Ur-Golem's Eye.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

339-677-1753-2034.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1494-4067-6822-6838.description:
If you have more than three cards in hand, activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card.
Repeat step 1 until you have three or fewer cards in hand.
At the beginning of your end step, Doctor Octopus triggers, causing you to draw at least five cards.
Lyla triggers for each card drawn, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

3490-4871-5315-6829.easyPrerequisites: You control an additional artifact creature.
3490-4871-5315-6829.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing any other creature you control.
When the creature dies, Venom and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Venom trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

413-4484-4871-5643-6709.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn
413-4484-4871-5643-6709.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Blasting Station and Geralf's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Geralf trigger,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Zombie Rogue.
When the Zombie Rogue dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Resolve the Ebondeath spell. When Ebondeath enters, Blasting Station and Geralf's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Geralf trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Ebondeath.
When Ebondeath dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
413-4484-4871-5643-6709.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

2707-4985-5751-6504.description:
Activate Conjurer's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, putting a land from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library and causing you to draw the land.
Cast Conjurer's Bauble from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {0} and discarding a land.
Repeat.

1055-5080-6498.description:
Cast Maddening Cacophony with kicker by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing each opponent to mill half their library, rounded up.
Activate Consuming Aberration by tapping it, causing a opponent to mill cards equal to the cards in opponents' graveyards, milling the remainder of their library.

2201-2558-5330-5687.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Godhead of Awe, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Atog ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-2038-4013.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Kozilek's Predator.
When Kozilek's Predator enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating six 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate three Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

232-618-3263-3525.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask token enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {3}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

974-1409-4919.notablePrerequisites:
Deadeye Navigator is paired with Dutiful Replicator.
There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
974-1409-4919.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Activate Dutiful Replicator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Dutiful Replicator enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Dutiful Replicator.
Resolve the Dutiful Replicator trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a copy of the Smaug token.
Put one of the Smaug tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Smaug dies, it triggers, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}.
Repeat from step 3.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead target any other token you control using Dutiful Replicator's ability.

232-1799-2048-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Priest of Urabrask, adding {1}.
Activate Epitaph Golem by paying {2}, putting Priest of Urabrask on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Priest of Urabrask into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Priest of Urabrask enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

732-3542-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Felhide Spiritbinder.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{U}{R}.
732-3542-4222.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}{R}.
Activate Freed from the Real's first ability by paying {U}, tapping Felhide Spiritbinder.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Felhide Spiritbinder.
Felhide Spiritbinder triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R} to create a token copy of Palinchron with haste.
The token Palinchron enters the battlefield, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.

1486-3750.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least 5 Dwarfs who do not have summoning sickness.
Opponents can not block.
1486-3750.description:
Attack with 5 Dwarfs, triggering Magda to create 5 Treasure tokens.
Sacrifice the 5 Treasure tokens for {3}{R}{R}.
Pay {3}{R}{R} to Aggravated Assault, gaining an extra combat phase and untapping all your creatures.
Repeat.

2003-3492-3609.notablePrerequisites: Coretapper does not have summoning sickness.
2003-3492-3609.description:
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Contagion Engine by paying {4} and tapping it, proliferating twice, putting two additional charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, taking an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
